resources.string: Draws the Dynamic Island around the camera, over any app and any home screen. It reads nothing on the screen; only “Screen text” in the island takes a screenshot, read on this device.
Needs “WEWEWE Island” in the accessibility settings, the only way Android lets apps draw around the camera.
The island works with the Pixel Launcher or any other home screen. Besides pulling the island down, these open the search:
WEWEWE Island is up to date (%1$s)
Allow WEWEWE Island to install apps, then tap again
%1$s installs by itself while the phone is not in use
Looks for updates every few hours, downloads them on Wi-Fi and installs them while the phone is not in use. The first update asks once for your OK.
